result.title: BehaviorFormer: Discovering Behavioral Patterns via Clusterable Next-Token Prediction
result.comment: Accepted at IEEE Conference on Games 2026
result.summary: Discovering behavioral patterns in open-ended games is challenging due to the lack of clear objectives or ground-truth annotations. In this work, we extend a next-token prediction Transformer with the deep clustering algorithm DCSS to learn meaningful representations with well-separated clusters. In a controlled Minecraft session with 26 players, the method discovers 23 distinct behavioral patterns that generalize across the studied players, further refining structures present in self-supervised representations into clearly separable clusters. We group the clusters into seven interpretable categories covering stationary, roaming, travel, mining, base work, logging, and farming behavior.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作把 next-token prediction Transformer 与深度聚类算法 DCSS 结合，在 26 名玩家的 Minecraft 会话中学习可分离的聚类表示，得到 23 种可跨玩家泛化的行为模式并归纳为七类。
